'''Mareil''' is one of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[First Twelve]].

== Appearance ==
She is tall and slender. She has shoulder-length hair which has as much white as black.

== History ==
She has been close friends with [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] since they were deckhands together. 

She is Wavemistress of Clan Mushien and one of the First Twelve of the Atha'an Miere. Her [[Windfinder]] is [[Tebreille din Gelyn South Wind]].

== Activities ==
She manages to get free from the [[Seanchan]] during the [[Escape]] from [[Ebou Dar]]. She attends the meeting of the First Twelve with [[Rand al'Thor]]'s ambassador [[Logain Ablar]]. Near the end of the meeting [[Cemeille din Selaan Long Eyes]] interrupts with the news of the [[Amayar]] committing mass suicide.
